body_en: Product material enters the machine from the top hopper and falls freely through the cylindrical detection coil. The coil generates a balanced electromagnetic field; when a ferrous or non-ferrous metal particle disrupts this field, the detector triggers an alarm and activates the pneumatic rejection valve. The separation flap opens momentarily to divert the contaminated stream to the waste bin, then closes to return the machine to normal operation. The system operates continuously with no moving parts in the product flow path during normal inspection.
